name: Password Sign-In Success
summary: A user enters through Welcome, chooses email authentication, submits valid password credentials, and reaches the resolved application landing destination with a normal authenticated session.
finalOutcome: The user has an authenticated normal session and the resolved application landing destination is active.

sourceReferences.note: Presentation reconciliation retains the shared Welcome and email/password surfaces and leaves successful landing host-directed rather than introducing an auth success confirmation view.
